name: ar-monotributo
description: Use this Guide for Argentina Monotributo in 2026: regimen simplificado, monotributista, categorias A a K, impuesto integrado, SIPA, obra social, recategorizacion, Factura C, Factura E, exclusion and renuncia. It covers individual small businesses and qualifying continuing estates, the current category parameters and monthly components, contribution exceptions, semestral review, invoicing, payment, exclusion and the general-regime handoff. It distinguishes January, February-July and August-onward
author: openaccountants
